title: Zellij Terminal Multiplexer
description: Modern terminal multiplexer — tabs, panes, floating windows, and session management.

entries.label: New Pane Right
entries.description: Split the current pane and open a new terminal to the right

entries.label: New Pane Down
entries.description: Split the current pane and open a new terminal below

entries.label: Navigate Panes
entries.description: Move focus between panes using arrow keys

entries.label: New Tab
entries.description: Create a new tab (workspace) in the current session

entries.label: Switch Tab
entries.description: Jump to a specific tab by number

entries.label: Floating Pane
entries.description: Toggle a floating pane overlay — great for quick commands

entries.label: Detach Session
entries.description: Detach from the current session (keeps it running in background)

entries.label: Reattach Session
entries.description: Reconnect to a previously detached session

entries.label: List Sessions
entries.description: Show all active Zellij sessions on this machine
